WITH customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        u.id AS user_id,
        u.full_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price_at_purchase) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders_count,
        MAX(o.created_at) AS last_order_at
    FROM users u
    JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
    JOIN order_statuses os ON os.id = o.status_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.created_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => $1)
      AND os.name <> $3
    GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM customer_sales
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    full_name,
    revenue,
    orders_count,
    last_order_at,
    revenue_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank <= $2
ORDER BY revenue_rank, user_id

WITH target_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.id,
        o.created_at,
        o.user_id,
        o.status_id,
        o.special_instructions
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.created_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => $1)
    ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
    LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
)
SELECT
    o.id,
    o.created_at,
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.full_name,
    os.name AS status_name,
    COUNT(oi.id) AS items_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price_at_purchase) AS order_total,
    COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT orf.flag_code, $4), $5) AS risk_flags,
    MAX(last_event.created_at) AS last_event_at,
    MAX(length(COALESCE(o.special_instructions, $6))) AS note_length,
    MAX(p.name) AS sample_product_name
FROM target_orders o
JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
JOIN order_statuses os ON os.id = o.status_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN order_risk_flags orf ON orf.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT el.created_at
    FROM order_event_log el
    WHERE el.order_id = o.id
    ORDER BY el.created_at DESC
    LIMIT $7
) AS last_event ON $8
WHERE o.special_instructions IS NULL OR length(o.special_instructions) >= $9
GROUP BY o.id, o.created_at, u.id, u.full_name, os.name
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name,
    c.name AS category_name,
    latest_price.price AS current_price,
    SUM(ws.qty_available) AS total_warehouse_stock,
    COALESCE(AVG(ss.qty_available), $3) AS avg_supplier_stock
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN warehouse_stock ws ON ws.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN supplier_products sp ON sp.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN supplier_stock ss ON ss.supplier_product_id = sp.id
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT pph.price
    FROM product_price_history pph
    WHERE pph.product_id = p.id
    ORDER BY pph.created_at DESC
    LIMIT $4
) AS latest_price ON $5
WHERE p.name ILIKE $1
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, c.name, latest_price.price
ORDER BY total_warehouse_stock DESC, p.id
LIMIT $2

SELECT 
		  pg_database.datname as datname,
		  tmp.mode as mode,
		  COALESCE(count, $1) as count 
		FROM 
		  (
		    VALUES 
		      ($2), 
		      ($3), 
		      ($4), 
		      ($5), 
		      ($6), 
		      ($7), 
		      ($8), 
		      ($9), 
		      ($10)
		  ) AS tmp(mode)
		  CROSS JOIN pg_database 
		  LEFT JOIN (
		    SELECT 
		      database, 
		      lower(mode) AS mode, 
		      count(*) AS count 
		    FROM 
		      pg_locks 
		    WHERE 
		      database IS NOT NULL 
		    GROUP BY 
		      database, 
		      lower(mode)
		  ) AS tmp2 ON tmp.mode = tmp2.mode 
		  and pg_database.oid = tmp2.database 
		ORDER BY 
		  1
SELECT pg_database_size($1)

SELECT
				pg_database.datname,
				tmp.state,
				tmp2.usename,
				tmp2.application_name,
				tmp2.backend_type,
				tmp2.wait_event_type,
				tmp2.wait_event,
				COALESCE(count,$1) as count,
				COALESCE(max_tx_duration,$2) as max_tx_duration
			FROM
				(
				  VALUES ($3),
				  		 ($4),
				  		 ($5),
				  		 ($6),
				  		 ($7),
				  		 ($8)
				) AS tmp(state) CROSS JOIN pg_database
			LEFT JOIN
			(
				SELECT
					datname,
					state,
					usename,
					application_name,
					backend_type,
					wait_event_type,
					wait_event,
					count(*) AS count,
					MAX(EXTRACT($9 FROM now() - xact_start))::float AS max_tx_duration
				FROM pg_stat_activity
				WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid()
				GROUP BY datname,state,usename,application_name,backend_type,wait_event_type,wait_event) AS tmp2
				ON tmp.state = tmp2.state AND pg_database.datname = tmp2.datname

WITH current_order AS (
    SELECT
        o.id,
        os.name AS current_status
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_statuses os ON os.id = o.status_id
    WHERE o.id = $1
),
next_status AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM order_statuses
    WHERE name = CASE
        WHEN (SELECT current_status FROM current_order) = $2 THEN $3
        WHEN (SELECT current_status FROM current_order) = $4 THEN $5
        WHEN (SELECT current_status FROM current_order) = $6 THEN $7
        WHEN (SELECT current_status FROM current_order) = $8 THEN $9
        WHEN (SELECT current_status FROM current_order) = $10 THEN $11
        ELSE $12
    END
)
UPDATE orders o
SET status_id = (SELECT id FROM next_status)
WHERE o.id = $1
RETURNING o.id, o.status_id, o.created_at
